## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria of the task met
- [ ] Card sub-tasks ticked
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] `dbt build` passing on the demos (when the change touches data)
- [ ] Business rules covered by tests
- [ ] Fictional data only; no secrets, client names, CNPJs or authorised e-mails (RNF-01, ADR 003)
- [ ] dbt columns follow the naming prefixes (RNF-05)
- [ ] About 400 changed lines or fewer (lockfiles and generated code excluded)
